reason: E2 directly supports the claim that an inverted BCC+B2 microstructure improves room-temperature ductility in RHEAs. However, no cited evidence supports the specific formation of such a microstructure by adding Ti to NbMoTaW, the ductile nature of B2 precipitates, their role as irradiation defect sinks, or the retention of high-temperature strength in this system.
